scoring.first_subgoal: first actual room crossing, key acquisition, boulder puzzle completion, exit success; missing retained as missing
scoring.move_accepted: room or local position changes, boulder moves, or exit reached
scoring.rule_reason_supported: reason and target corroborated by current visible room or observed guide memory

scoring.goal_hint_consistent: one-hot goal, target offset and current visible target agree
